title: fix(ui): in a narrow record drawer a relative time stays on one line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34614

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Refs #34696: the card's "badge cut to one letter" symptom moved there. Measured, it is `record:path`'s desktop stage row in a narrow drawer. That card is in development by another dev in this area and touches `record-path.tsx` only.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:窄记录抽屉里的相对时间不再逐词换行。元信息行的「· 3 天前」、动态条目、折叠条目和回复的时间都成了不可拆开的一段;行在各段之间换行,放不下时整段时间移到下一行。
- **为什么改**:在 380px 抽屉里实测，元信息行的 "2 days ago" 拆成两三行，动态条目的「3 天前」拆成「3」和「天前」。卡片的另一半(徽标被截成一个字母)经实测不成立：选项徽标本来就在自身内部加省略号并带 title,所以没有改代码，只加了一个 e2e 对照钉住它。真正被截成一个字母的是阶段条(`record:path`)的桌面行，已转到 #34696。
- **风险与回滚**:只改了三个渲染文件的 class 与一层包裹,没有元数据、spec、新 i18n key 或导出改动。宽屏下行能放下就不换行，外观不变(900px 对照的块高度前后一致)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordMetaFooter.tsx`(`MetaEntry` 的 `data-record-meta-when` 一段)、`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`(条目头 `data-feed-when` 和系统行 `data-stream-when`)、`ui/e2e/narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui run test:e2e --project=chromium e2e/narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts`,预期 6 passed(380/400px 时间各占一行，900px 对照，徽标完整或带省略号和 title)。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **Meta line** (`RecordMetaFooter.tsx`, `MetaEntry`). The dot and the `time` element now sit inside one `inline-flex … whitespace-nowrap` unit (`data-record-meta-when`), and the entry becomes `flex-wrap` (`data-record-meta-entry`). In a narrow drawer the entry wraps between label, user and that unit, so "· 2d ago" moves to the next line whole. Before, the time was a shrinkable item of a row that could not wrap, so it broke word by word. An entry without an actor carries the unit without a dot.
2. **Activity timeline** (`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`). The entry header and the folded-run header become `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5`, and their time span is `whitespace-nowrap` (`data-feed-when`). On the stream face, the compact system line keeps "· time" as one nowrap unit (`data-stream-when`) after a separate break space, so its text reads byte-for-byte as before.
3. **Replies** (`ThreadedReplies.tsx`). The reply header gets the same treatment as the entry it replies to.

**Badges: nothing to change (the card's item 2 was falsified by measurement).** The select / status / multiselect badge already truncates inside itself: `SelectCellRenderer`'s `Badge` is `max-w-full min-w-0` around an inner `truncate` span, with the label as its `title`. In a 380px drawer, on the real record page in Chromium (default page and a hand-written page), 「方案报价」-length labels were whole, and long labels ended in an ellipsis with the title. No badge was cut silently at 375 / 380 / 400 / 900px. The new e2e badge control pins this. `HeaderHighlight.tsx` is not in the diff. The one-letter cut that does happen in a narrow drawer is `record:path`'s desktop row, which is viewport-keyed: seven stages read "P… ✓… Pro… Ne…". It moved to #34696.

## Why

The card measured a 380–400px record drawer. The time lines broke per word there: "2 / days / ago" on the meta line, and "3" over "天前" in an entry header.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/narrowDrawerTime-34614.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases, class shape: jsdom has no layout). The meta unit is nowrap and holds the dot and the time; the entry is flex-wrap; the no-actor entry has no dot; the entry, folded and reply headers are flex-wrap with a nowrap time; the system line keeps the break space outside its unit, with unchanged text.
- `ui/e2e/narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts` (new, 6 cases, Chromium geometry, in the pattern of `record-path-phone-row.spec.ts`). It reads the real class strings out of `RecordMetaFooter.tsx`, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `HeaderHighlight.tsx` (default-page grid cell), `ui/badge.tsx` and the select badge in `@object-ui/fields`, and every extraction throws on drift. It compiles real Tailwind for exactly those classes. The cases: at 380 and at 400px, the meta times are one line each and the long entry's time moved down whole; at 380 and at 400px, the entry time is one line and moved to a line of its own; a 900px control keeps both on one line; a badge control shows 「方案报价」 whole and a long label ellipsised, with its title and inside its cell.

Ablations (each fix committed first, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- **`whitespace-nowrap` dropped from the meta unit → caught by the jsdom pin, NOT by the e2e spec.** `narrowDrawerTime-34614.test.tsx` went 2 failed / 5 passed ("draws the dot and the time inside one unbreakable unit", and the no-actor control). The e2e spec stayed green (6 passed): the unit (about 70px) is a flex item of the now `flex-wrap` entry, so it moves to a fresh line whole either way. `nowrap` only matters when the unit alone is wider than a line.
- **`flex-wrap` dropped from the meta entry → the e2e spec goes red**: 2 failed / 4 passed, both meta cases (380, 400), "Expected: at least 51.5, Received: 28". The time stayed on its label's row.
- **`flex-wrap` dropped from the activity entry header → the e2e spec goes red**: 2 failed / 4 passed, both entry cases (380, 400).

## Acceptance notes

- Claim surface amendment 6941237713 (area o3-A) covers the new `ui/e2e/` spec and names `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` and `ThreadedReplies.tsx`.
- Same shape, not changed (outside the drawer's 动态 timeline): `RecordComments.tsx`'s header (a legacy `DetailView` surface) has its time in a non-wrapping flex row. `ActivityTimeline.tsx` puts its time on its own line, and `HistoryTimeline`'s header is already `flex-wrap`, so neither breaks per word.
- ui `AGENTS.md` #2 asks for README / `content/docs/frontend/` updates. No page there describes the meta line or the timeline header layout, so none was edited.

## Verification

All on head `acf4cd7347` (origin/main `77b42a1ed0` merged) unless noted. Logs are folded.

<details><summary>Reproduction readings (one-off, not committed)</summary>

The real components' DOM was laid out in Chromium with real Tailwind, plus the real `RecordDetailView` mounted with a stub data source in a 380px drawer.

- Before: the meta time "2 days ago" took 3 lines at 375px and 2 lines at 380px; the entry header time took 2 lines at 380px (en / de / zh) and at 400px (en / de).
- After: every time took 1 line in every scenario (24 / 24).
- 900px control: block heights are identical before and after (meta 29px, timeline 199px).
- Badges in a 380px drawer: 「方案报价」 / 「无需审批」 / 「老客户增购」 / 「客户推荐」 were whole (69–81px wide); long labels were ellipsised (95–110px) with the title.
</details>
